title: Bali vs Thailand: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Thailand for food, variety, and infrastructure. Bali for culture, private villas, and surf. Do both if you have 3+ weeks.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Thai cuisine is world-class at every price point. Bali has great café culture but can't match Thailand's depth.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Thailand wins for calm swimming and variety across Andaman and Gulf coasts. Bali wins for surf and dramatic cliffs.

categories.name: Culture & Temples
categories.summary: Bali's Hindu culture is uniquely immersive — 20,000 temples, daily ceremonies, rice terraces. Thailand has more temples but Bali goes deeper.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Private pool villas at $40–80/night give Bali a huge accommodation edge. Street food is comparable.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Bangkok MRT, cheap domestic flights, trains, ferries — Thailand's transport infrastructure is far superior to Bali's scooter-or-car reality.

categories.name: Digital Nomad Life
categories.summary: Canggu (Bali) for vibe, Chiang Mai (Thailand) for affordability. Both are top global nomad hubs.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Bangkok never sleeps; Full Moon Party is legendary. Bali's beach clubs are more beautiful but Thailand has more variety.

faq.question: Is Bali or Thailand better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: If you have 2+ weeks, Thailand's diversity wins. For 7–10 focused days, Bali is hard to beat.

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Bali or Thailand?
faq.answer: Comparable overall. Bali wins on villa accommodation; Thailand wins on food, beer, and city transport.

faq.question: Which has better beaches?
faq.answer: Thailand for calm swimming; Bali for surfing and dramatic cliff scenery.
